name: CDC Open Data (data.cdc.gov, Socrata SODA)

provider.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

summary: Free SODA REST API over the CDC's open data portal: chronic disease indicators, mortality, COVID-19, wastewater, vaccination and hundreds of other public-health tables.
description: data.cdc.gov runs the Socrata Open Data platform, so every dataset is queryable at /resource/{4x4-id}.json with SoQL ($select, $where, $group, $order, $limit, $offset, $q full-text search). A Discovery API at /api/catalog/v1 lists and searches the portal's datasets, and /api/views/{id}.json returns column metadata. Many of the most-downloaded CDC entries on data.gov (U.S. Chronic Disease Indicators, NCHS leading causes of death, provisional COVID-19 death counts, wastewater viral activity) are served from this host. The same API shape works on other Socrata portals.

auth.notes: Works without credentials; an optional free Socrata app token (header X-App-Token or $$app_token parameter) gives a per-application throttling pool instead of the shared per-IP pool.

rate_limit.summary: No numeric limit documented. Without an app token requests share a per-IP pool and can be throttled with HTTP 429; with a token Socrata says it does not throttle unless use is abusive.

endpoints.summary: Discovery API: search datasets on the portal
Dataset metadata: columns, license, update time

license.name: Varies per dataset (the example dataset is ODbL 1.0; others are public domain or unspecified)

coverage.geographic: United States, mostly national, state and county level

agent_notes: Find a dataset id with /api/catalog/v1?domains=data.cdc.gov&q=<topic>&only=datasets, then GET /resource/<id>.json. All values come back as strings (counts and rates included), so cast in SoQL (e.g. $where=datavalue::number > 10) or client side. Use $select=count(*) for row counts and $group for aggregates. Default page size is 1000 rows; $limit=60000 returned 60000 rows in a test, so large pages work. Page with $limit and $offset plus a stable $order. The fields of a dataset are listed in the X-SODA2-Fields response header. For per-column docs open /api/views/<id>.json.
caveats: Numeric columns are returned as JSON strings.
The Discovery API without domains=data.cdc.gov searches every Socrata portal (a plain /api/catalog/v1?limit=1 returned a Dallas police dataset).
Dataset licenses differ; read license.name in /api/views/{id}.json before reuse.
Documented throttling is described qualitatively only; no numbers were found.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without an app token. Catalog count for domains=data.cdc.gov: 1084 datasets at check.
